2609.08105.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Digital Inventory of Cultural Heritage & Traditional Knowledge: Case for Indonesian Open Digital Library of Culture
2609.08105.paper_summary: The Indonesian Digital Library of Culture (Perpustakaan Digital Budaya Indonesia, PDBI; budaya-indonesia.org) is a participatory platform that has collected tens of thousands of entries on Nusantara cultural heritage through public contribution since 2007. Manual contribution faces three structural barriers: coverage (knowledge is scattered across languages and sites), integrity (open sources mix authentic documentation with noise), and completeness (subjects are recorded but their data remain shallow). This paper presents a methodological framework for autonomous, AI-based harvesting of cultural knowledge from the open web, designed to expand corpus coverage while intensifying per-entry data depth. The methodology is organised as a five-stage economic funnel: focused crawling, multilingual extraction and canonicalisation, vector encoding with blocking, agentic decision-making, and idempotent publication, under the principle of deterministic orchestration, agentic decisions. Each stage is formalised: funnel economics and optimal filter ordering; crawl-frontier dynamics as a subcritical branching process that explains the necessity of recurrent re-seeding; fact-level novelty via a containment measure; Bayesian multi-source evidence fusion with elevated publication thresholds for sacred categories; exactly-once effects via idempotent upserts and the transactional outbox; sliding-window inference budgeting with a reservation protocol; statistical quality auditing; and seed selection as submodular coverage maximisation. The framework retains four high-value human roles: curator of direction, escalation approver, quality auditor, and guardian of meaning, while machine autonomy is raised in stages. Ethical, legal, and cultural-sensitivity implications are discussed, including the architectural guarantee that the machine never overwrites human contributions.
2609.08105.paper_summary_zh: 印尼數位文化圖書館（Perpustakaan Digital Budaya Indonesia, PDBI；budaya-indonesia.org）是一個參與式平台，自2007年以來通過公眾貢獻收集了數萬條有關群島文化遺產的條目。手動貢獻面臨三個結構性障礙：覆蓋範圍（知識分散在不同語言和網站上）、完整性（開放資源將真實文檔與噪音混合）、以及完整性（主題被記錄，但其數據仍然淺薄）。本文提出了一個基於自主AI的文化知識自動收集的方法論框架，旨在擴大語料庫的覆蓋範圍，同時加深每條目的數據深度。該方法論組織為五階段的經濟漏斗：專注爬取、多語言提取與標準化、向量編碼與阻塞、代理決策，以及冪等出版，遵循確定性編排和代理決策的原則。每個階段都有其形式化：漏斗經濟學和最佳過濾排序；爬取邊界動態作為一個亞臨界分支過程，解釋了重複重新播種的必要性；通過包含度量實現事實層面的新穎性；以提高的出版門檻進行的貝葉斯多源證據融合，針對神聖類別；通過冪等更新和事務性發送箱實現的精確一次效果；帶有預留協議的滑動窗口推理預算；統計質量審計；以及作為子模塊覆蓋最大化的種子選擇。該框架保留了四個高價值的人類角色：方向策展人、升級批准者、質量審計員，以及意義守護者，同時機器自主性逐步提升。文中討論了倫理、法律和文化敏感性影響，包括架構保證機器永遠不會覆蓋人類貢獻。
2609.08105.author: Hokky Situngkir et.al.
